objective: Implement the zero-extra-spend ChatGPT-plan reviewer bridge described in GitHub issue #3. The bridge must replace the current manual copy/paste Astra-review step with an autonomous reviewer path after one explicit user OAuth authorization. It must use OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT plan sharing, never a separately billed API key, discover the signed-in account's model catalog, use the exact gpt-6-astra model only if that catalog exposes it, and fail closed without paid fallback when plan usage/Astra is unavailable. GPT-6 Astra remains reviewer-only: it may approve/reject and emit structured corrections, but it must not implement changes or merge. The first runtime target is a self-hosted Windows GitHub Actions reviewer bridge with no local AI inference; all model inference remains on OpenAI cloud.

official_openai_contract_verified_2026_1.loopback_callback_requirement: HTTP on 127.0.0.1 with /auth/callback; port may vary but host/path/scheme must match authorization and token exchange
official_openai_contract_verified_2026_1.model_catalog_endpoint: GET https://api.openai.com/v1/models with OAuth bearer token; choose only models returned by the signed-in account
inference_requirements: send complete required context in input
do not use ChatGPT backend-api endpoints
official_openai_contract_verified_2026_1.refresh: grant_type=refresh_token with issued client_id, current refresh_token and resource=https://api.openai.com/v1; successful refresh rotates refresh_token
official_openai_contract_verified_2026_1.token_lifetimes: access tokens approximately 1 hour; refresh tokens approximately 30 days and replaced on successful refresh
official_openai_contract_verified_2026_1.zero_spend_behavior: If included ChatGPT-plan usage is unavailable/exhausted or gpt-6-astra is absent, stop/block. Do not use an API key, purchased credits, automatic credit purchases, or any other paid route.
official_openai_contract_verified_2026_1.conversation_access: Sign in with ChatGPT does not grant access to existing ChatGPT conversations or memories.

constraints: USD 0 extra spend. Do not use OPENAI_API_KEY or any separately billed OpenAI API credential.
Do not enable or consume purchased ChatGPT credits and do not instruct the runtime to turn on automatic credit purchases. If included plan usage is unavailable, return a blocked/waiting state.

Do not hard-code or assume gpt-6-astra availability. Query the authorized account's current /v1/models catalog and use the exact slug gpt-6-astra only when it is actually listed. If absent, return BLOCKED_NO_ASTRA.
Never call ChatGPT backend-api/private endpoints. Use only documented Sign in with ChatGPT OAuth and public /v1/models and /v1/responses endpoints.
No local AI inference. The Windows self-hosted host is only an OAuth/token/reviewer bridge.
Do not access, scrape, export, or claim access to this ChatGPT conversation or ChatGPT memory. Reviewer continuity must come only from repository reviewer/context files.

Never commit, upload, echo, print, include in exceptions, or place in GitHub artifacts/comments any access token, refresh token, ID token, OAuth authorization URL containing id_token_hint, API key, GitHub token, or other credential.
Use a stable opaque ext_agent_host_id per host. Do not use email, username, machine name, GitHub username, or another identifying value as the host ID.

First registration must use dynamic_agent_client only for authorization; persist and reuse the issued oaiapp client_id for that account/workspace. Never save dynamic_agent_client as the issued client id.
Validate OAuth state, PKCE, OIDC nonce, ID-token signature via OpenAI JWKS, exact issuer, audience equal to issued client_id, expiry, and account identity before storing/replacing credentials.
Require chatgpt.tokens.use.direct in granted scopes before inference.

Store credentials only in protected local runtime storage. On Windows prefer DPAPI or an equivalently OS-protected store; on Unix/self-hosted VM use atomic owner-only 0600 storage. Tests must use fake/in-memory stores and synthetic tokens only.
Serialize refreshes for one profile and atomically replace access+refresh token set because refresh tokens rotate.

The reviewer must bind every review to exact repository, PR number, base SHA, candidate SHA, required CI run IDs/results/digests, changed-file manifest, review packet, reviewer rules, prior findings, and safety boundaries.
Never approve a SHA different from the SHA actually reviewed. Never re-review an already terminally reviewed SHA except after an infrastructure/auth failure that produced no reviewer verdict.
Astra can only emit APPROVED or REJECTED structured review output. It has no repository implementation authority and no merge authority.
No auto-merge. APPROVED must persist exact-SHA approval and stop at the existing explicit merge/promotion gate.

REJECTED must be translated into a bounded correction task/event for the existing free-worker/controller loop. The review result workflow must validate schema, exact SHA, reviewer identity/model, and idempotency before any write.

All GitHub Actions permissions must be minimum necessary. The self-hosted reviewer request workflow should not expose ChatGPT credentials to arbitrary PR code and must never run untrusted candidate code on the self-hosted host.

The self-hosted reviewer job must operate only on trusted main-branch bridge code and fetch candidate material through GitHub APIs/artifacts as inert data; do not checkout/execute the candidate PR on the credential-bearing self-hosted runner.
Keep pc_cleanup_mode=AUDIT_ONLY, local_video_inference=false, spend_limit_usd=0.
functional_requirements: Implement a Python reviewer bridge with commands for host initialization, interactive Sign in with ChatGPT authorization, token refresh, model catalog discovery, exact-SHA review execution, and offline/dry-run validation.

The sign-in command must create/reuse a stable opaque host ID, start a 127.0.0.1 loopback listener, generate fresh state/nonce/PKCE, open the system browser, validate callback state/error/client_id semantics, exchange the code using the issued client_id, validate the ID token and scopes, then atomically store the protected profile.
Use official endpoints in official_openai_contract_verified_2026_10_04. Avoid undocumented behavior.

Implement token refresh before expiry using the saved issued client_id and rotating refresh token. Serialize refreshes and atomically replace the full token set. Terminal refresh errors must transition to NEEDS_REAUTH; temporary network/5xx errors must not erase valid stored credentials.

Implement model discovery from /v1/models using the selected OAuth bearer token. Select only visibility=list models. The reviewer path must require the exact slug gpt-6-astra; otherwise BLOCKED_NO_ASTRA.

Implement Responses API review with store=false and stream=true. Treat success only after response.completed. Handle response.failed, interrupted stream, and subscription_sharing_usage_limit_exceeded/subscription_sharing_usage_unavailable as non-paid blocked states with no billing fallback.

Use a strict JSON/schema review contract with terminal statuses APPROVED or REJECTED plus reviewed_sha, model, evidence summary, and structured findings. Reject malformed model output; do not infer approval from prose.

Build compact reviewer input entirely from repository-controlled context/evidence. Include reviewer instructions, project context, safety boundaries, exact PR diff/file list or bounded patches, review packet, prior review history, and exact CI evidence. Do not use this ChatGPT conversation directly.

Create a self-hosted Windows GitHub Actions workflow that is triggered only after the reviewer-bridge regression for a candidate succeeds, verifies exact candidate SHA and prerequisite CI, then invokes only trusted main-branch bridge code on a specifically labeled self-hosted runner. It must never checkout/execute candidate code on the credential-bearing host.
The reviewer workflow must post or dispatch only a sanitized structured result. Tokens/profile contents must remain local and must not be uploaded as Actions artifacts.

Create a GitHub-hosted result-consumer workflow for sanitized review results. It must be idempotent and exact-SHA-bound. APPROVED records approval without merging. REJECTED validates the finding schema and creates/dispatches a bounded correction instruction for the existing free-worker loop without using another paid/ChatGPT model.

Create a GitHub-hosted deterministic regression workflow with no real OAuth/token/network requirement. Tests must use synthetic credentials, fake HTTP/GitHub transports, and assert no secret-bearing data can enter logs/results/artifacts.
Provide reviewer context files that encode the current project rules and the review behavior developed in this conversation without claiming access to the conversation itself.

Document one-time Windows setup for the self-hosted runner and Continue with ChatGPT authorization, including that the PC must be online for automatic review. Do not run installation or OAuth automatically from GitHub-hosted workers.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover PKCE/state/nonce generation and validation, dynamic-registration issued-client-id handling, missing chatgpt.tokens.use.direct, ID-token validation failure paths, stable host ID persistence, rotating refresh token atomic replacement, concurrent refresh serialization, temporary refresh failure preservation, and terminal refresh NEEDS_REAUTH.

Unit tests cover /v1/models parsing, exact gpt-6-astra selection, BLOCKED_NO_ASTRA when absent, visibility filtering, no model relabeling, plan-usage exhausted/unavailable blocked states, stream ending without response.completed, response.failed, and malformed review JSON.

Unit tests cover exact-SHA binding, same-SHA idempotency, mismatched SHA rejection, APPROVED/REJECTED schema validation, rejected correction packaging, retry ceiling behavior, and no merge/auto-merge commands.
Unit tests prove synthetic access/refresh/ID tokens and authorization URLs containing id_token_hint never appear in sanitized outputs, review result JSON, GitHub payloads, logs, or artifacts.
Workflow static/integration tests prove the credential-bearing self-hosted workflow checks out only trusted main bridge code and does not checkout or execute PR candidate code.
Workflow tests prove reviewer runs only after required exact-head CI is green and fails closed when evidence is missing, stale, ambiguous, or refers to another SHA.
Workflow/result tests prove APPROVED persists exact-SHA approval but never merges; REJECTED produces one bounded correction event/task and repeated delivery is idempotent.
README and docs state clearly that Sign in with ChatGPT does not provide existing ChatGPT conversation/memory access and that repository reviewer context is the continuity mechanism.

Review packet remains PENDING_ASTRA_REVIEW, truthfully lists all generated artifacts/tests/limitations, and does not claim a live ChatGPT authorization or live Astra inference before the user actually completes OAuth.
CURRENT_STATE keeps spend_limit_usd=0, local_video_inference=false, astra_role=reviewer and pc_cleanup_mode=AUDIT_ONLY.
PROVENANCE_REGISTRY records each TASK-0003 generated/modified artifact accurately.
reviewer_focus: zero-spend enforcement and no API-key/credit fallback
model-catalog truthfulness and exact gpt-6-astra requirement
